200.description: The session in a definitive state (COMPLETED, DECLINED, REQUOTE_REQUIRED or FAILED).

Idempotency-Replayed.description: Set to `true` on a replay of a stored answer (a retry carrying the same Idempotency-Key, method, path and body), and only on a replay: the first execution of a key never carries it.

orderId.description: Set when the network's place-order step succeeds (COMPLETED).

requotedOffers.description: Present in REQUOTE_REQUIRED; the BFF writes them into the cart as a new quote.

deliverByEarliest.description: Calendar day of the destination: the requoted window's earliest instant read in the offer's time zone (UTC when the network names none, ADR 0008).

deliverByLatest.description: Calendar day of the destination: the requoted window's latest instant read in the offer's time zone (UTC when the network names none, ADR 0008).

202.description: An outcome is unknown: the authorization (the session stays AUTHORIZING; ResolveStuckAuthorizations re-calls with the same key after 2 minutes) or the place-order step (the session stays PLACING, the semantic lock). Poll GET /checkout-sessions/{sessionId}.

400.description: malformed-request, idempotency-key-required (no Idempotency-Key header) or idempotency-key-invalid (not 1-128 printable ASCII characters).

type.description: Problem type slug, for example placement-in-doubt.
